headline: 🔥 **A FOURTH TOUR BOOKS ON 225 WILLOW POINT TONIGHT AT 6:45 — AND THE AGENT HAS NEVER SEEN THE HOUSE.** Angela W. of ARC Realty 280 booked at 1:31 this afternoon for 6:45–7:15 PM: a third separate brokerage, her first showing here, and the fourth booking this listing has taken since Friday. ⭐ SHE IS WALKING IN COLD INTO A HOUSE THAT PRODUCED TWO “INTERESTED” VERDICTS THIS MORNING and has not had its $185,000 argued once. 🎯 The sellers already told you they will take showings any hour, the ad spend is renewed, and Darrell is cutting in the living-room trim himself. ⚠️ The only loose end is unchanged since noon: the sellers' written answer on the ceiling and the closet reached one of the two interested agents, not both.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 A SECOND INTERESTED PARTY IN ONE MORNING, AND SHE CAME BACK ON HER OWN. Molly G. of Keller Williams Hoover — the agent who took the FIRST showing this listing ever had, Friday 8/21 at 4:30 — texted Gene's phone unprompted at 10:27 AM: her buyers are interested, they “actually really liked it,” and the only things holding them back are the living-room ceiling that looked like old water damage and the closet that was never patched. ⭐ SHE ASKED THE IDENTICAL TWO ITEMS Anna C. raised at 9:47, which means two independent buyer parties walked out of this house worried about the same two cosmetic things — and nothing else.
hotSignals.action: 📞 CALL HER, DO NOT EMAIL — she chose the phone twice now. ⭐ THE WHOLE ANSWER IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND APPROVED BY YOUR SELLERS: the closet is the only access to the shower plumbing, new fittings were sweated in about a year ago, and the sheetrock was deliberately left open as an access hatch; the living-room ceiling was a toilet-line leak from the hallway guest bath that was repaired, with no ongoing leak. 🎯 BOTH ARE RESOLVED-AND-EXPLAINED, NOT DEFECTS — that is the strongest possible answer to hand a buyer who already likes the house. ⚠️ That answer went to Anna C. at 11:31 and never reached Molly; she has now been waiting on it for over two hours. Then ask the only question that matters: what would it take to get your buyers back for a second look this week.

hotSignals.signal: 🎉 FIRST-EVER FEEDBACK ON THIS LISTING, AND THE PRICE WENT UNCHALLENGED. Anna C. of A Squared Properties replied at 9:47 AM, twenty minutes after your email: her buyers “really liked it,” the house “showed very well,” and every concern she raised is cosmetic by her own description. ⭐ You asked point-blank how $185,000 read against what else they have seen — and she did not take up the number at all. 🔍 She also disclosed she was COVERING for Lindsey H., so Saturday's two showings were one buyer party.
hotSignals.action: 🎯 ANSWER HER THREE QUESTIONS TODAY — that is the whole move, and two of the three need your sellers first: is the living-room ceiling crack a settled Sheetrock joint, is crown molding going back in or being cut in with paint, and is the patched laundry-room ceiling an intentional access panel for the bathroom above. ⭐ A buyer who liked the house, never argued the price, and named three fixable cosmetic worries is one clear answer away from a second look. ⚠️ Do NOT let a machine answer this one — she is already in a live thread with you and replied to you personally in twenty minutes.

hotSignals.signal: 🎉 IT CONVERTED. The showings on this address stopped mattering Sunday evening when the seller and the buyers agreed — price, concessions and both sides at two and a half — and the closing office opened the contract for signature at 8:06 this morning. This board's oldest live signal is now a deal.
